verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability ingest endpoint stores production calls sent by the agent or a provider's post-call webhook and automatically schedules metric evaluation on them. Retell call data is pulled every 30 seconds without webhook setup, and metric sampling lets teams evaluate a percentage of live calls to control cost. LLM-judge and Python metrics evaluate each call, and the site claims live drift detection across every call. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of online evaluation at production scale, and detail on real-time vs. post-call latency (Cekura's 'evaluators' term refers to simulations, so online scoring runs through metrics)
